Helpful Tooth Learning Prompts

Use these ideas to turn tooth facts into simple conversations, classroom moments, and healthy routines.

At Home

Make brushing visible, consistent, and calm. Let children ask questions about loose teeth and dentist visits.

In Class

Use tooth timelines, counting activities, and anatomy cards to connect science with everyday habits.

Next Steps

Start with one topic, then revisit the care tips until healthy habits feel familiar.
